items.name: Vitamin D3 60,000 IU/week (loading) + 2,000 IU/day maintenance
items.form: cholecalciferol softgel (e.g., HK Vitals D3 60k, Carbamide Forte D3 60k)
items.dose: 60,000 IU once weekly × 8-12 weeks, then 2,000 IU/day; ALWAYS WITH FATTY MEAL for absorption
checks_passed: Conditions: no CKD / hemochromatosis / sarcoidosis → cleared
Allergens: cholecalciferol from lanolin (wool) — no wool allergy noted → cleared
Dose: physician-supervised loading range for severe deficiency (<20 ng/mL) → cleared

items.name: Vitamin K2 (MK-7) 100µg/day
items.form: MK-7 menaquinone (e.g., Carbamide Forte K2, Wellbeing Nutrition K2 MK-7)
items.rationale: Direct Ca to bone/teeth not soft-tissue during high-dose Vit D loading

items.name: Magnesium glycinate 300-400mg before bed
items.form: magnesium bisglycinate (e.g., HK Vitals Mg Glycinate, Now Foods Mg Glycinate)
items.rationale: Vit D synergy (Mg is cofactor for 25-OH-D → 1,25-OH-D conversion) + sleep onset support + RBC-Mg often suboptimal at serum 2.02
checks_passed: Medications: no diuretics / no ACE-I → cleared
Conditions: no CKD → cleared (Mg is renally cleared)

items.name: Omega-3 EPA+DHA 2g/day
items.form: marine fish oil softgel; 3rd-party tested for heavy metals (e.g., Carbamide Forte triple-strength, Setu omega-3, Unived OmegaPure)
items.rationale: From R-ATO-01 (Th2 modulation) + general CV optimization; addresses missing omega-3 index marker
checks_passed: Allergens: no fish allergy → cleared (else switch to algal omega-3)
checks_warnings: Verify product is 3rd-party tested (IFOS / NSF) for heavy metals — Bay of Bengal and Arabian Sea fish-derived oils need this check.

items.name: Quercetin 500mg × 2/day with meals
items.form: dihydrate (e.g., Setu Quercetin, Now Quercetin with Bromelain)
items.rationale: From R-ATO-01 (mast-cell stabilization + Th2 modulation); strongest evidence in atopic/allergic adults
checks_passed: Medications: no anticoagulant → cleared (quercetin has mild blood-thinning at high doses but 1g/day is within safety)
items.evidence_tier: E3 — limited but mechanistic + small RCTs

items.name: Whey protein 2 scoops/day (continuing)
checks_passed: Allergens: dairy not flagged → cleared (verify lactose tolerance — minimal in isolate)
Dose: 50g whey + dietary protein keeps total well under 2.0 g/kg ceiling

items.name: Creatine monohydrate ~5g/day (continuing)
checks_passed: Conditions: no CKD → cleared (creatine + CKD interaction does not apply at eGFR 105)
Dose: standard 0.07 g/kg ≈ 5.8g — current 5g is conservative
items.note: Creatine elevates serum creatinine ~0.1-0.2 mg/dL; current 1.02 includes this. eGFR derived from creatinine may slightly underestimate true kidney function. Cystatin C confirmation recommended at retest.

items_considered_but_skipped.name: Ashwagandha KSM-66 600mg/day
items_considered_but_skipped.reason_skipped: Originally would have fired from R-HOR-03 (stress) BUT downgraded — PSS-4 = 4 (LOW), mood 7-8, no GAD-2 signal. Adding ashwagandha at low-stress baseline = unnecessary and adds adaptogen load. Revisit only if cortisol AM persists elevated AFTER circadian shift at retest, or if PSS-4 rises.

items_considered_but_skipped.name: Methylated B-complex
items_considered_but_skipped.reason_skipped: Folate 8.10 + B12 508 + homocysteine 7.46 are all in range. Mild RDW signal can be monitored. Skip unless RDW persists elevated at retest.
